digest.component_or_area: S2 CLI parser and route registry
propositions: A stdlib-only CLI parser foundation and immutable route registry must be defined with a factory protocol and deterministic ArgumentParser customization that produces byte-identical help output and parse errors without resolving handlers or optional dependencies.

Route records must hold lazy handler and parser-factory references plus metadata (identity, alias, visibility, help, mount/init, confirmation/output, capability) and validate duplicate spellings, illegal alias/retired collisions, contradictory policies, unknown capabilities, and malformed references without resolving command handlers.
Registry construction and route lookup must provably import neither handlers nor optional packages, enforced by import-isolation tests running in isolated subprocess contexts.

The formatter policy must deliver fixed-width deterministic output (command/option ordering, UTF-8 LF, one trailing newline) independent of terminal width and compatible with legacy help files and execution paths.
Retired routes and legacy bridge spellings must be excluded from derived policy-set exports and shipped ROUTES, with validation and composition mechanisms tested on synthetic routes.
